make_or_buy_basis: A controlled location schedule separates fixed PRM/call-button/signage/emergency-light equipment from operator-replenished extinguishers, first aid and seals.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: cleanable UV/chemical-resistant labels, radiused tamper-resistant brackets and protected emergency battery/connector interfaces
material_spec.form_factor: fixed equipment installed to the released location schedule; replenishable/expiring contents remain separately recorded operator stock
material_spec.governing_standard: selected national accessibility/fire rules plus supplier fire, photometric, battery-duration, extinguisher/bracket, label-durability and lifecycle evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: passenger call controls, tactile/visual labels, battery-backed exit markers, certified extinguisher/first-aid brackets, tamper seals and common adapters
material_spec.material_family: controlled PRM and emergency-equipment location kit
material_spec.nominal_section: reachable controls, contrast/tactile content, illuminated sightlines, bracket loads, egress keep-outs and service access fixed by project review
material_spec.traceability: equipment serial/batch, label revision/language, battery date, extinguisher/first-aid expiry, seal number and installed location audit

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: SOURCE supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Exact lamp models, optics, voltage variants and emergency battery arrangement remain open.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Local luminaires are acceptable at the standard plug and mounting cassette after photometry, glare, fire, EMC, IP, emergency-duration and temperature tests.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: rail interior, emergency and exterior lighting
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
